title: Enrol with AUSTRAC before providing a designated service
what: A person who starts to provide a designated service must apply to be entered on the Reporting Entities Roll within 28 days, and then meets the Act's program and reporting obligations.

laws.title: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2006

sources.title: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2006
sources.quote: 51B Reporting entities must enrol (1) If: (a) a person commences to provide a designated service; and (b) the person’s name is not entered on the Reporting Entities Roll; the person must, no later than 28 days after the day on which the person commences to provide the designated service, apply under subsection 51E(1) for enrolment
